breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt requested an output at T=0.6, which contradicted the specified time domain of t in [0, 0.5]. The ground truth corrected this by changing the output time to T=0.5. The agent successfully identified and fixed this error, consistently using T=0.5 as the final time throughout the generated specification, as seen in the lines 'Compute dt0 = 0.9 / (|a|/dx + |b|/dy), then Nt = ceil(T/dt0) with T = 0.5' and 'Compute the solution u(x,y,T=0.5)'.
